title: The Fairground Lemonade Cash Register
statement:
At a lemonade stand, each lemonade costs $5. Customers stand in a queue and buy one lemonade at a time, paying with either a $5, $10, or $20 bill.

You must provide the correct change to each customer so that the net transaction is $5. You start with no money.

Print "YES" if you can provide every customer with correct change, or "NO" otherwise.
inputFormat:
First line: Integer N.
Second line: N space-separated bills (5, 10, or 20).

sampleCases.explanation: We collect $5, $5, $5, give $5 change for $10, then give $10 + $5 for $20.
For the last $20, we need $15 change but only have $10 bills.
